cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a street food stall at night under a tarp — holds a bowl of hot food at chest height; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — dries her hair with a towel; a rocky coast path with tide pools — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a medieval tavern — holds her keepsake at chest height; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — sitting on the ground; a sheltered coastal ferry waiting area with coloured glass wind screens — she holds a paper pinwheel against the breeze to pass the wait; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — holds her keepsake at chest height; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — sets a small hand lantern down on the ground beside her; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — seated on a chair; a sunny beach with wet sand and shallow surf — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a red carpet and award hall with camera flashes — standing; a misty enchanted garden of moss — holds a small bouquet at chest height
